_comment: US-859. Serious+critical axe node counts per authenticated route, re-measured 2026-09-11 against fixtures the screens actually need: a household that resolves (US-857), a pantry with food in it (US-858) and two children with a week of meals (US-859). Every earlier number was of a degraded or empty screen -- the dashboard read 3 with no household, the pantry's 46 was AppContext's starter seed, and planner read 0 because with no kids it renders one sentence and a button. Scanned with a child, the planner returned eight aria-progressbar-name violations on its first run; they are fixed and it reads 0 again. These numbers may only go DOWN: the assertion is <=. Regenerate deliberately with A11Y_BASELINE=update --workers=1, never to turn a red run green.
_measurementNote: The 12 remaining nodes are all white text on one of two colours: #16a249 (hsl 142 76% 36%, which is --secondary and --safe-food, the same colour defined twice) at 3.33:1, and #f97015 (hsl 24 95% 53%, --try-bite) at 2.85:1. Both are ratchets in src/lib/themeContrast.test.ts with the lightness each needs; see US-858 for why the change is an owner's decision. Unnamed progress bars elsewhere in the tree are tracked in src/lib/progressBarNames.test.ts. RATCHETED 2026-09-18 (US-821): grocery 3 -> 0 and pantry 8 -> 3, measured on three consecutive runs of one build. US-822 darkened --secondary and --safe-food from 36% to 27% lightness in the same session, which removes every #16a249 node this note describes. What is left is #f97015 (--try-bite) only, still a ratchet in src/lib/themeContrast.test.ts and still an owner's decision per US-858, because its arithmetic fix collapses it into --primary. RATCHETED 2026-09-18 (US-817): recipes 1 -> 0. That node was the "Most Popular" Badge at Recipes.tsx:610, slate #0f1729 on the darkened --secondary #117937 at 3.24:1 -- not a token problem but src/styles/mobile-first.css colouring `.text-xs`, which is in the Badge base class list, after Tailwind had already emitted .text-secondary-foreground. The remaining 3 on the pantry are still #f97015 (--try-bite), unchanged and still an owner's decision per US-858. Measured on two consecutive runs of one dist-e2e build, with scripts/dev/fake-postgrest.mjs now seeding out-of-stock and in-stock foods as well as low: every row was quantity 1 before, so no scan had ever rendered an out-of-stock card.
